messages.subject_clean: Jackknife test and Permutation Importance on enviro data
messages.body_plain:
Hi Dimitris,

You can use the same code of user-specified rasters as a template to load your LGM rasters. Then, you just need to use the predict() function.

Best,
Gonzalo
